errors.rules.behavior-target-missing: Behavior {kind} refers to {target}: there is no such field in the form.
errors.rules.render-selector-missing: Rule {kind} addresses node {selector}, which is not in the schema — it will do nothing at runtime.
errors.rules.validation-target-missing: A validation rule targets {target}: there is no such field in the form.
errors.schema.array-initial-value-incomp: The array initialValue is missing element keys: {keys}. Those fields would have no signal.
errors.schema.array-initial-value-missin: The array has no initialValue: Add would create an empty element and the template fields would render nothing.
errors.schema.duplicate-node-id: Node “{node}” appeared twice in the file — the id was reissued. Save the file, or the duplicate stays.
errors.schema.html-tag-not-allowed: Tag {tag} is not allowed in $html(...): presentational tags only.
errors.schema.invalid: The schema does not pass validation: {message}
errors.schema.model-path-unbound: {hint, select, yes{No field declares the model path {path} here, so it will have no value. Did you mean {suggestion}?} other{No field declares the model path {path} here, so it will have no value.}}
errors.schema.not-a-form: This is not a form schema: the file has no root node.
errors.schema.out-of-range: The value is out of range: it must be {op} {limit}.
errors.schema.parse-failed: The file is not valid JSON: {message}
errors.schema.pattern-mismatch: The value has the wrong shape: {expected} is expected here.
errors.schema.unknown-component: Component {name} is not in the kit catalog.
errors.schema.unknown-data-source: There is no data source named {name}.
errors.schema.unknown-locale-key: Locale key {key} is not in the catalog.
errors.schema.value-not-allowed: {list, select, yes{The value is not one of the allowed ones: {allowed}.} other{The value is not one of the allowed values.}}
errors.structure.panel-without-tab: No tab leads to panel {value} — its content is unreachable.
errors.structure.panel-without-value: The panel has no value — it cannot be reached.
errors.structure.step-not-container: {name} stands as a wizard step — a step must be a container that fields go into.
errors.structure.tab-without-panel: Tab {value} has no panel — it opens nothing.
errors.structure.tab-without-value: The tab has no value — it will open no panel.
errors.structure.tabs-default-value-unkn: defaultValue {value} matches no tab — nothing will be selected when the form opens.
quickfix.replace-component: Use the closest name from the catalog
